name: First Job
source: Become Arisiel - an inexperienced incubus on his first day at work. Meet one of three possible partners and try your best at getting your little grabby hands on their energy in this short, created in Ren'Py, visual novel.
translation: 成为阿莉希尔，一名第一天上班、毫无经验的梦魔。在三名可能的搭档中遇见其中一人，努力从他们身上吸取能量。这是一部使用Ren'Py制作的短篇视觉小说。
